newsitem.title: GERMANY: Two killed, four hurt in Hamburg brothel shootout.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, four hurt in Hamburg brothel shootout.

text.p: Two men were killed and four injured in a shootout in a brothel in Hamburg's St Pauli red light district in the early hours of Sunday, police said.
Four or five masked men armed with shotguns stormed into the "Blue Night" brothel and opened fire, a police spokesman said.
Several of the guests apparently returned fire immediately.
Two men, a German and a Turk, died at the scene. A 29-year-old Bosnian man believed to be one of the attackers was later found in a nearby hotel with gunshot wounds, the spokesman said.
Police said they did not yet know the motive for the attack.
Two brothel guests were taken to hospital with serious injuries.
A fourth injured man, a 22-year-old Turk who appeared to have been caught in the crossfire, took himself to hospital and was later questioned by police, the spokesman said.
Germans were horrified two years ago by the murder of six people in a high-class Frankfurt brothel.
